title: Tribological properties of cold-sprayed 7075Al coatings reinforced with hybrid nano-TiB2/micro-SiC particles
InformationInFigures: Yes. Microhardness (Fig. 8), Nanohardness and elastic modulus (fig. 9)

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical shape with some local micro-satellite structure. small grains inside

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: coatings exhibited considerable denseness and were free of cracks. particles were largely deformed during deposition, forming a very dense structure except for the presence of some small pores at the inter-particle regions.

Experiments.Notes: Pure 7075Al. top-surface and cross section hardness both given, reported is cross section. Also method section states the unit is HV0.1 but the graph has HV0.3.

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical shape with some local micro-satellite structure. small grains inside. ultra fine TiB2 particles uniformly distributed inside the composite particles

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: fabrication of the composite powder is detailed in a previous paper (composition not in present paper)

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: coatings exhibited considerable denseness and were free of cracks. particles were largely deformed during deposition, forming a very dense structure except for the presence of some small pores at the inter-particle regions.

Experiments.Notes: TiB2/7075Al. top-surface and cross section hardness both given, reported is cross section. Also method section states the unit is HV0.1 but the graph has HV0.3.

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical shape with some local micro-satellite structure. small grains inside. SiC is irregularly shaped
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: average size of SiC powder was 29 μm

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: coatings exhibited considerable denseness and were free of cracks. surface of coating had some globular and irregular protrusions. These could be particles that had not yet been fully deformed (without the impact of subsequent particles resulting in less deformation) and the bonding of these particles might not be very good. traces can be observed left by some bouncing particles. reinforcing particles were uniformly distributed and no significant delamination of the particles from the matrix was observed.  the interfaces between the coatings and the substrates showed mutual jagged embedment.

Experiments.Notes: Pure 7075Al + SiC. top-surface and cross section hardness both given, reported is cross section. Also method section states the unit is HV0.1 but the graph has HV0.3.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: fabrication of the composite powder is detailed in a previous paper (composition not in present paper)

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: coatings exhibited considerable denseness and were free of cracks. surface of coating had some globular and irregular protrusions. These could be particles that had not yet been fully deformed (without the impact of subsequent particles resulting in less deformation) and the bonding of these particles might not be very good. traces can be observed left by some bouncing particles. the nanoTiB2 particles were well retained. reinforcing particles were uniformly distributed and no significant delamination of the particles from the matrix was observed.  the interfaces between the coatings and the substrates showed mutual jagged embedment.
